text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Geez!
Just listen to what I'm saying!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Orfe!
You tell these guys too!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You guys are my familiars!
Obey your master!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: ...You expect me to reason with a beast?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Hoh, baring your fangs at the king, are you?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Such insolence, you beasts.
...Bow down and revere me.

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
"...Then again, trying to reason with a beast is foolish.
In that case—"

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: Transcend the language barrier—and engrave it into instinct.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
No way!?
My familiars are bowing down...?!

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text: I see. ...Whether Umamusume or beast, the primal instinct of fear remains unchanged.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hey, how did you just do that?!
Is it magic?! It's magic, isn't it! Tell me!

Perhaps because she had acquired a new sensation,
Orfevre's running took on
even greater sharpness from that day forward.
